name: Bloggy Bob
cadence: on request (Run now, or a Drive order naming Bob)

sources.label: posts already published on our WordPress sites

does: Drafts one SEO blog post per request, following the Bloggy Bob spec and voice profile
Checks keyword ownership first, and proposes a refresh instead of a duplicate post
Scores every draft on the 13-point checklist
When a WordPress post is approved, saves it to that site as an unpublished draft

traits.instead: Saves an unpublished WordPress draft; a person publishes

traits.cant: Post to Squarespace (The Cordelle, Saint Elle, Estelle)
traits.instead: Lays the post out in the order Squarespace asks for it, ready to paste
Writes (unverified) or leaves the fact out
